title: Morocco just voted. Most people didn't.
status: script: animations marked 'planned' still need to be built in anim.py; voice clips not yet generated

head: 6 IN 10 MOROCCANS
DIDN'T VOTE
scenes.say: Morocco just held an election. And more than six in ten voters stayed home.
scenes.show: Morocco just held an election. And more than 6 in 10 voters stayed home.

head: A KINGDOM
THAT VOTES
scenes.say: Morocco is a kingdom, but its three-hundred-and-ninety-five-seat parliament is elected every five years.
scenes.show: Morocco is a kingdom, but its 395-seat parliament is elected every five years.

head: THE RULE THAT
DECIDES EVERYTHING
scenes.say: The King picks the head of government from the party that wins the most seats.
scenes.show: The King picks the head of government from the party that wins the most seats.

head: PAM
COMES FIRST
scenes.say: This time, that's PAM, with ninety-seven seats, up from eighty-seven.
scenes.show: This time, that's PAM, with 97 seats, up from 87.

head: THE RULING PARTY
CRASHED
scenes.say: The R-N-I, which led the government, fell from one hundred and two seats to sixty-six.
scenes.show: The RNI, which led the government, fell from 102 seats to 66.

head: THE ISLAMISTS
ARE BACK
scenes.say: The Islamist P-J-D quadrupled its seats, from thirteen to fifty-four, and says it will stay in opposition.
scenes.show: The Islamist PJD quadrupled its seats, from 13 to 54, and says it will stay in opposition.

head: WHY SO
ANGRY?
scenes.say: Last year, Gen Z protesters marched for jobs, hospitals and schools, not World Cup stadiums.
scenes.show: Last year, Gen Z protesters marched for jobs, hospitals and schools, not World Cup stadiums.

head: THE COALITION
PUZZLE
scenes.say: PAM needs about one hundred more seats, and it has ruled out its old partner, the R-N-I.
scenes.show: PAM needs about 100 more seats, and it has ruled out its old partner, the RNI.

head: A WOMAN
AT THE TOP?
scenes.say: If the King picks PAM leader Fatima-Zahra El Mansouri, she'd be the Arab world's second woman to lead a government.
scenes.show: If the King picks PAM leader Fatima-Zahra El Mansouri, she'd be the Arab world's second woman to lead a government.

head: BARELY
MADE THE NEWS
scenes.say: Morocco just reshaped its parliament, and it barely made the news. That's the blind spot.
scenes.show: Morocco just reshaped its parliament, and it barely made the news. That's the blind spot.

head: SEND THIS TO
SOMEONE WHO HASN'T HEARD
scenes.say: Send this to someone who hasn't heard.
scenes.show: Send this to someone who hasn't heard.
